'''First Weaver''' is the title of the [[Ajah Heads|Head]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].

==Title holders==
The current First Weaver is [[Suana Dragand]]. She was also a [[Sitter]] for the Yellow in the [[Hall of the Tower during the White Tower Schism|Tower Hall during the Schism]]. Among the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]], this post was held by [[Romanda Cassin]], who also served as a Sitter during the Schism. She found it easy to obtain a place as Ajah Head because she had been First Weaver before she retired. After the reunification, Suana remained First Weaver, but gave her seat in the [[Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere|new Hall]] to Romanda.
